title: A guarded nest
hook: Parental care varies among animal species.

knows: Animals have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The diagram shows an adult near a nest with eggs. Some crocodilians guard nests or care for young; this illustrative scene does not claim every adult or every species behaves identically.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: A crocodilian stays close to a nest in this illustrated example. What could it help protect?
